destination: All Doom gameplay, world simulation, AI, BSP traversal, and rasterization are circuit-owned; no DoomGeneric game loop or renderer executes.
moduleABI: CircuitModuleV1 / ABI 1 / exact-i32-u32-v1 (future programs); existing command graphs retain fp32-exact-v1

coverageMetric.name: circuit-owned core modules / enumerated core modules
coverageMetric.meaning: A migration ledger count, not a fraction of executed instructions or gameplay behavior.

hostBoundaries: audio-device I/O for circuit-selected logical events

contract.capacities: Every input/state/table/prior-event and output/delta/event span carries an explicit count/capacity; module-specific maxima belong to versioned manifests.
contract.failure: Every non-exact status has zero output, state-delta, and event counts; no partial commit.
contract.soundOwnership: Circuits select and order logical sound/music events; the host only performs audio-device I/O.

modules.fallback: reference-C on out-of-domain input, Metal error/2 ms timeout, or mismatch
reference-C on out-of-domain input, Metal error/2 ms timeout, or mismatch

modules.exitCriterion: CircuitScheduler drives all core modules without executing DoomGeneric gameplay or renderer objects.
